title: Value of e to the power of ln of an integer
source: Theory P23-2.7 Quick check 1 (e^{ln 7}=7); inverse of ln, new positive integers

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The natural logarithm and the exponential function are inverses, so \(e^{\ln {k|int}}={A|int}\).
steps.note: A equals k. Original k=7 gives 7.

title: Value of ln of e to an integer power
source: Theory P23-2.7 Quick check 2 (ln(e^5)=5); inverse of exp, new integers

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The natural logarithm and the exponential function are inverses, so \(\ln\bigl(e^{{k|int}}\bigr)={A|int}\).
steps.note: A equals k. Original k=5 gives 5.

title: Solve a two-term natural-log equation with integer solution
source: Theory P23-2.7 Quick check 3 (ln(x+8)-ln x = ln 5, x=2); difference of logs, new integer families
stem: Solve the equation \(\ln(x+{C|int})-\ln x=\ln {b|int}\). What is the value of \(x\)?

steps.name: M
steps.note: Use the subtraction law and drop the logarithms. C is k(b-1).

steps.name: A
steps.note: A equals k. Original k=2, b=5 gives C=8 and x=2.

title: Solve ln(x+1) minus ln x equals 2 ln 2

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2020), Question 1, written as ln(x+1)-ln x = 2 ln 2 (the official grouping, confirmed by the MS identity (x+1)/x=4). Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 9709/21/M/J/20 Question 1, taken from the official QP.

Solve the equation
\(\ln(x+1)-\ln x=2\ln 2\).  [3]

steps.name: M1
steps.text_tex: The subtraction law produces one logarithm on the left-hand side: \(\ln\bigl((x+1)/x\bigr)=2\ln 2\).
steps.note: Official MS Q1: M1 for using a correct logarithm property to produce one term on the LHS.

steps.name: M2
steps.text_tex: Then \((x+1)/x=2^2=4\), which is an equation without logarithms.
steps.note: Official MS Q1: M1 for using a correct process to obtain an equation without logarithms. Independent: 2 ln 2 = ln 4.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: So \(x+1=4x\) and \(x=\dfrac{1}{3}\). This value is positive, so both logarithms are defined.
steps.note: Official MS Q1: A1 for (x+1)/x=4 or equivalent and hence x=1/3.
